Col.description: Vertical layout. Without gap it spaces blocks like an article.

Row.signature: Row(children: Node[], gap?: number, align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between", wrap?: boolean)
Row.description: Horizontal layout; items are vertically centered.

Box.signature: Box(children?: Node[], direction?: "row" | "col", gap?: number, padding?: number, background?: Color, radius?: Radius, border?: boolean, width?: Length, height?: Length, flex?: number, align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between", wrap?: boolean)
Box.description: Flex container, a column by default. radius also clips the content.

Grid.signature: Grid(children: Node[], columns?: number, minChildWidth?: number, gap?: number)
Grid.description: Equal columns (default 2). With minChildWidth (px), columns drop on narrow screens.

Card.signature: Card(children: Node[], variant?: "outline" | "soft", padding?: number, gap?: number)
Card.description: Panel with a border; soft is a filled panel for summaries.

Carousel.signature: Carousel(children: Node[], itemWidth?: number, gap?: number)
Carousel.description: Horizontal row that scrolls and snaps, each child an item itemWidth px wide (default 240): photos, cards, options, days.

Popover.signature: Popover(trigger: string | Node[], content: string | Node[])
Popover.description: Shows content in a small panel when the trigger is clicked: a definition, a source, details behind an Icon("info", "sm").

Spacer.description: Fills the free space in a Row.

Title.description: Heading; md for a card title, lg for a section, 2xl for a big number.

Text.signature: Text(text: string | Node[], size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", color?: Color, weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold", italic?: boolean, lineThrough?: boolean, tabularNums?: boolean, maxLines?: number)
Text.description: Paragraph; supports **bold**, *italic*, `code` and [links](https://…). text may be a list mixing strings and inline components: [Icon("clock", "sm"), " 25 min · ", Badge("Easy")].

Badge.description: Pill tag; icon is an optional leading lucide name.

Link.description: Opens an http(s) URL in a new tab.

List.description: timeline joins the markers with a line.

ListItem.signature: ListItem(title: string, description?: string, marker?: string, children?: Node[])
ListItem.description: marker replaces the bullet or number, e.g. a time or an emoji.

Markdown.description: Prose with headings, lists, quotes, code and tables.

Quote.description: A quotation or a callout with a side rule; cite names the source.

Code.description: Code block with a copy button.

Math.description: LaTeX formula, e.g. Math("E = mc^2"); inline true to sit in a Text list.

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "solid" | "outline" | "soft" | "ghost", color?: "primary" | "danger" | "success", size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", icon?: string, disabled?: boolean, block?: boolean)

IconButton.signature: IconButton(icon: string, action?: ActionExpression, label?: string, variant?: "outline" | "ghost" | "solid")
IconButton.description: Round icon-only button; label is read aloud.

Pressable.signature: Pressable(children: Node[], action?: ActionExpression, selected?: boolean, padding?: number, background?: Color, radius?: Radius)
Pressable.description: Makes any content clickable, such as a tile or a swatch.

Input.signature: Input(value: $binding<string | number>, label?: string, type?: "text" | "number", placeholder?: string)
Input.description: Text or number field; a number field stores numbers.

TextArea.signature: TextArea(value: $binding<string>, label?: string, placeholder?: string, rows?: number)

Select.signature: Select(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string})[], label?: string, placeholder?: string)

SegmentedControl.signature: SegmentedControl(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string})[], block?: boolean)
SegmentedControl.description: 2 to 4 short choices in a row.

Slider.signature: Slider(value: $binding<number>, min: number, max: number, step?: number, label?: string, unit?: string, marks?: {value: number, label: string}[])
Slider.description: Shows label and value; unit like "%" or "$" formats the value.

Checkbox.description: lineThrough strikes the label when checked, for to-do lists.

RadioGroup.signature: RadioGroup(value: $binding<string>, options: (string | {value: string, label: string, description?: string})[], label?: string, variant?: "list" | "pills" | "cards")
RadioGroup.description: pills for short choices; cards for choices that need a description line.

DatePicker.signature: DatePicker(value: $binding<string>, label?: string, min?: string, max?: string)

Timer.description: Countdown with start, pause and reset. It counts the bound seconds down to 0, so other statements can react, e.g. $left == 0.

Form.description: Groups fields; their values go with any @ToAssistant inside.

SearchImage.signature: SearchImage(query: string, aspectRatio?: number, radius?: Radius, fit?: "cover" | "contain")
SearchImage.description: A real photo the app finds for query; it needs no URL and no tool. Name the exact thing in 2 to 4 words: "Belém Tower Lisbon", "iPhone 17", "pastel de nata". Use one for every place, dish, product or thing with a look.

Image.signature: Image(src: string, alt: string, aspectRatio?: number, radius?: Radius, fit?: "cover" | "contain")
Image.description: Photo from a URL the user or a tool gave; if it fails, a photo is found for alt.

Table.description: Each row lists its cells in column order; a cell may be a component. Number columns align right.

Chart.signature: Chart(type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie" | "donut" | "scatter", data: Record<string, string | number>[], x?: string, series?: string[], format?: "number" | "currency" | "percent", currency?: string, stacked?: boolean, height?: number)
Chart.description: Rows of data; x is the category key (a number key for scatter), series the value keys (default: every number key). percent values are like 45; currency is a code like "EUR".

Map.signature: Map(markers: MapMarker[], route?: boolean, selected?: $binding<string>, height?: number)
Map.description: Street map fitted to its markers. route draws the road path in marker order; selected holds the clicked marker's label.

MapMarker.signature: MapMarker(label: string, lat: number, lng: number, category?: string, icon?: string)
MapMarker.description: A place on a Map; icon is one emoji, else the pin shows its number.

YouTube.description: Embedded YouTube video by id or URL. Only a video you know exists.

Flashcard.signature: Flashcard(front: string | Node[], back: string | Node[], hint?: string)
Flashcard.description: Card that flips between front and back when tapped. Put several in a Carousel or Grid.

Celebration.description: Bursts confetti when its condition turns true, e.g. Celebration($score == 5) at the end of a quiz.

Svg.signature: Svg(children: Node[], viewBox: string, width?: Length, height?: Length)
Svg.description: A drawing for steps, parts, mechanisms, diagrams and layouts. Scales to its width; its shapes take expressions, so state can move them.

Circle.signature: Circle(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Ellipse.signature: Ellipse(cx: number, cy: number, rx: number, ry: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Rect.signature: Rect(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number, rx?: number)

Line.signature: Line(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Path.signature: Path(d: string, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Polyline.signature: Polyline(points: string, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, fill?: Color, opacity?: number)

Polygon.signature: Polygon(points: string, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

G.signature: G(children: Node[], transform?: string, opacity?: number)

SvgText.signature: SvgText(text: string, x: number, y: number, size?: number, fill?: Color, anchor?: "start" | "middle" | "end", weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold")

HtmlView.signature: HtmlView(html: string, height?: number, title?: string)
HtmlView.description: Sandboxed HTML page with inline JS, for games and canvas. No network except script CDNs. Fits its content unless height is set.

componentGroups.name: Layout
notes: - gap and padding count 4px steps. Length is px or a CSS length like "50%". Radius is "sm", "md", "lg", "xl", "full" or px.
- Color is "ink", "muted", "faint", "surface", "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "purple", "pink", "chart1" to "chart6", or a CSS color. As a background, status colors are soft tints.

componentGroups.name: Inputs
notes: - An input's first argument is its value, usually a $variable that other statements read.

- Every input either changes something shown on the page, or sits in a Form whose submit Button sends a short first-person @ToAssistant ("Help me choose a bike"); the form values go with it. No dead inputs.

Append.description: Copy of the list with item added at the end

Prepend.description: Copy of the list with item added at the start

Remove.signature: Remove(list: any[], field: string, value: any) → any[]
Remove.description: Copy without the items whose field equals value; field "" compares the items themselves

RemoveAt.description: Copy without the item at index (0-based; negative counts from the end)

Update.signature: Update(list: any[], field: string, value: any, setField: string, setValue: any) → any[]
Update.description: Copy where items whose field equals value get setField set to setValue

Toggle.description: Adds item if missing, removes it if present (a set of strings or numbers)

Includes.signature: Includes(list: any[] | string, item: any) → boolean
Includes.description: True if the list has item, or the text contains it

Find.signature: Find(list: any[], field: string, value: any) → any
Find.description: First item whose field equals value, or null

IndexOf.description: Index of item in the list, or -1

Take.description: The first n items; a negative n takes the last n

Slice.signature: Slice(list: any[] | string, start: number, end?: number) → any[] | string
Slice.description: Items, or characters of text, from start up to end (not included); negative counts from the end

Range.signature: Range(start: number, end: number, step?: number) → number[]
Range.description: Numbers from start up to end (not included) by step (default 1), e.g. @Range(0, 3) is [0, 1, 2]

Pick.description: A random item, or null for an empty list; draws anew each time, so call it inside @Set

Shuffle.description: Copy in random order; call it inside @Set

Flatten.description: One list from a list of lists, e.g. [[1, 2], [3]] is [1, 2, 3]

Chunk.description: The list cut into lists of size items, e.g. for weeks of 7 days or pages

Sqrt.description: Square root; null for a negative number

Random.signature: Random(min: number, max: number, integer?: boolean) → number
Random.description: Random number from min to max (integer true: a whole number, max included); draws anew each time, so call it inside @Set

Clamp.signature: Clamp(number: number, min: number, max: number) → number
Clamp.description: number kept between min and max

Percent.description: part / total * 100, e.g. @Percent(3, 4) is 75; 0 when total is 0

Lerp.signature: Lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number) → number
Lerp.description: The value a fraction t of the way from a to b

Allocate.signature: Allocate(total: number, weights: number[], decimals?: number) → number[]
Allocate.description: Splits total in proportion to weights, rounded to decimals (default 2), so the parts add up to exactly total, e.g. @Allocate(100, [1, 1, 1]) is [33.34, 33.33, 33.33]

Payment.signature: Payment(principal: number, rate: number, periods: number) → number
Payment.description: Payment per period that repays principal over periods at rate percent per period, e.g. a 30-year loan at 6% a year: @Payment(300000, 6 / 12, 360)

Convert.signature: Convert(value: number, from: string, to: string) → number
Convert.description: value from one unit to another: mm cm m km in ft yd mi; mg g kg oz lb st; ml l tsp tbsp floz cup pt qt gal (US); m/s km/h mph kn; m2 km2 ft2 ha acre; c f k

Format.signature: Format(value: number, kind?: "number" | "currency" | "percent" | "compact", decimals?: number, currency?: string) → string
Format.description: Number as text: "number" 12,345.6, "currency" $12,345.68 (currency is a code like "EUR"), "percent" 45 -> 45%, "compact" 1.2M ($1.2M with a currency)

Join.signature: Join(list: any[], sep?: string, field?: string) → string
Join.description: Joins the items (or their field) into text with sep (default ", "), skipping nulls

Plural.signature: Plural(n: number, word: string, plural?: string) → string
Plural.description: Count and word: @Plural(1, "guest") is "1 guest", 3 gives "3 guests"; plural defaults to word + "s"

Pad.signature: Pad(value: string | number, length: number, char?: string) → string
Pad.description: Pads the start of value to length with char (default "0"), e.g. 7 -> "07"

Trim.description: Text without spaces at the start and end

Capitalize.description: Each word with a capital first letter, e.g. "new york" is "New York"

Split.description: List of the parts of text between sep (default ","), each trimmed, empty parts dropped, e.g. @Split("a, b,,c") is ["a", "b", "c"]

Replace.signature: Replace(text: string, find: string, replacement: string) → string
Replace.description: Text with every find replaced by replacement

Default.description: value, or fallback when value is null, "" or not a number, e.g. an empty number input: @Default($weight, 0)

MixColor.signature: MixColor(from: string, to: string, t: number) → string
MixColor.description: The hex color a fraction t of the way from one hex color to another, e.g. @MixColor("#ffffff", "#0285ff", 0.5) for a heatmap or a tint

Now.description: The current date and time as an ISO string

Today.description: Today's date in the viewer's time zone, as "YYYY-MM-DD"

FormatDate.description: A date as text: "date" Oct 9, 2026 (default), "short" Oct 9, "long" Friday, October 9, 2026, "weekday" Fri, "month" Oct 2026, "time" 9:30 PM, "datetime", "iso" 2026-10-09. Dates are "YYYY-MM-DD", ISO or a timestamp

AddDays.signature: AddDays(date: string | number, days: number) → string
AddDays.description: The date days later (negative: earlier), as "YYYY-MM-DD"

AddMonths.signature: AddMonths(date: string | number, months: number) → string
AddMonths.description: The date months later (negative: earlier), kept within the month (Jan 31 + 1 is Feb 28), as "YYYY-MM-DD"; 12 months is a year

DaysBetween.signature: DaysBetween(from: string | number, to: string | number) → number
DaysBetween.description: Calendar days from one date to another (negative if to is earlier)

MonthsBetween.signature: MonthsBetween(from: string | number, to: string | number) → number
MonthsBetween.description: Whole months from one date to another (negative if to is earlier); @Floor(@MonthsBetween(birthday, @Today()) / 12) is an age

StartOf.description: First day of the date's "week" (Monday), "month" or "year", as "YYYY-MM-DD"

GroupBy.signature: GroupBy(rows: any[], key: string, field?: string, agg?: "sum" | "avg" | "count" | "min" | "max") → {key: string | number, value: number}[]
GroupBy.description: One row per distinct key, in first-seen order; value is agg of field (default "sum"), or the row count without a field

Pivot.signature: Pivot(rows: any[], rowKey: string, colKey: string, field?: string, agg?: "sum" | "avg" | "count" | "min" | "max") → Record<string, string | number>[]
Pivot.description: One row per rowKey value with a column per colKey value holding agg of field, for stacked or grouped charts

Top.signature: Top(rows: any[], field: string, n: number, direction?: "desc" | "asc") → any[]
Top.description: The n rows with the largest field ("asc": the smallest)

Between.signature: Between(rows: any[], field: string, min?: any, max?: any) → any[]
Between.description: Rows whose field is from min to max, both included; compares numbers, or text such as "YYYY-MM-DD" dates. Leave min or max null for an open end

Bucket.signature: Bucket(rows: any[], dateField: string, unit: "day" | "week" | "month", field?: string, agg?: "sum" | "avg" | "count" | "min" | "max") → {key: string | number, value: number}[]
Bucket.description: Rows per day, week (from Monday) or month of dateField, in date order, empty periods 0 for sum and count; key is "YYYY-MM-DD", or "YYYY-MM" for months

Cumulative.description: Copy of the rows with field replaced by its running total (field "" for a list of numbers)

MovingAvg.signature: MovingAvg(rows: any[], field: string, window: number) → any[]
MovingAvg.description: Copy of the rows with field replaced by the average of its last window values (field "" for a list of numbers)

Change.description: Percent change from previous to current, e.g. @Change(120, 100) is 20; null when previous is 0

Histogram.signature: Histogram(values: number[], bins: number, min?: number, max?: number) → {key: string, value: number, start: number, end: number}[]
Histogram.description: Counts numbers into equal-width bins (value is the count); min and max fix the range, default the data's

Stats.signature: Stats(values: number[]) → {count: number, min: number, max: number, mean: number, median: number, stdev: number}
Stats.description: Summary of numbers, all zeros for an empty list

CopyToClipboard.description: Copy text to the clipboard, e.g. a shopping list built with @Join
